usage: The word 蜥蜴 (sik1 jik6) is used to refer to lizards specifically, a type of reptile commonly found in warm environments.
As a noun, 蜥蜴 (sik1 jik6) can be used as the subject or object in a sentence when talking about these animals.
You can describe the actions or characteristics of a 蜥蜴 (sik1 jik6) by adding verbs or adjectives before or after the noun.
When using 蜥蜴 in sentences, it often appears with classifiers like 一隻 (jat1 zek3) meaning 'one (small animal)'.
蜥蜴 can also appear in informal contexts, such as commenting on seeing a lizard at home or outside.
